summary: Smart Campus Automation System integrating IoT, AI, and cloud technologies to automate and optimize university campus operations with scalability, security, and user-friendly design
architectural_notes: System must support horizontal scalability for growing campus needs
IoT devices should use standard protocols (MQTT, CoAP) for interoperability
AI models should be cloud-based for centralized processing and updates
Implement end-to-end encryption for all data transmission
Use microservices architecture for modularity and maintainability
imageRequirements:
## Required Images
- Modern isometric illustration of a smart campus with connected buildings and IoT sensors, using mint green and slate gray color scheme (hero-campus.dim_1200x400.png)
- Icon set for device types: temperature sensor, occupancy sensor, energy meter, lighting control, HVAC control in mint green line style (device-icons.dim_512x512.png)
- Abstract geometric pattern background representing data connectivity and optimization in subtle mint and gray tones (pattern-bg.dim_1920x1080.png)

existing_features.title: Create a frontend dashboard displaying real-time campus operations overview with device status summary, active alerts count, current sensor readings, and system health metrics
Build frontend device management interface with searchable/filterable list of all IoT devices, showing type, location, status, and last reading, with ability to view device details and history
Create frontend automation rules interface where users can create, edit, enable/disable rules with visual condition builder and action selector
Build frontend analytics view displaying historical sensor data with interactive charts showing trends over time, energy consumption patterns, and occupancy analytics by building or zone
Create frontend alerts and notifications panel showing active alerts sorted by severity, with filtering options and ability to acknowledge or resolve alerts
Build frontend AI recommendations view displaying optimization suggestions with priority, estimated impact, implementation instructions, and accept/dismiss actions

Create a visually cohesive design system with a modern tech-forward aesthetic using mint green and slate gray as primary colors, with clean geometric layouts and subtle data visualization accents that convey efficiency and intelligence

new_feature_requests.summary: IoT device integration for campus sensors and actuators
Security framework for system access and data protection
User-friendly interface for campus operations management
Create a backend data model for campus IoT devices including device ID, type (sensor/actuator), location (building, room), status (online/offline), and last reading timestamp
Implement backend functions to record and retrieve sensor readings (temperature, humidity, occupancy, energy consumption) with device ID, value, unit, and timestamp
Create backend automation rules system where rules define conditions (sensor thresholds) and actions (actuator commands) with enable/disable status
Implement backend optimization engine that analyzes sensor data patterns and generates recommendations for energy savings, space utilization, and operational efficiency
Build backend alert system that triggers notifications when sensor values exceed thresholds or devices go offline, with severity levels and acknowledgment tracking
Implement role-based access control with at least three roles: Admin (full system access), Operator (device monitoring and rule management), and Viewer (read-only access to dashboards and analytics)
